pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to match against emails.

engine.description: The regex engine to use. One of 'extended', 'basic', or 'perl'.

ignore_case.description: If true, ignore case distinctions in matching.

invert_match.description: If true, select messages which don't match the pattern.

match_headers.description: If true, match the pattern against message headers.

match_body.description: If true, match the pattern against message body.

mailbox_format.description: The format of the input/output mailbox. One of 'mbox', 'zmbox', 'bz2mbox', 'mh', 'nnml', 'nnmh', 'maildir'.

file_lock.description: File locking method. One of 'fcntl', 'flock', or 'none'.

suppress_errors.description: If true, suppress most error messages.

count_only.description: If true, suppress normal output and print a count of matching messages.

output_mailbox.description: Path to write matching messages to instead of printing them. Empty string means no output redirection.

pipe_command.description: Command to pipe each found message to. Empty string means no piping.

delete_matching.description: If true, delete selected messages instead of displaying them.

recursive.description: If true, descend into directories recursively.

mailboxes.description: List of mailbox paths to process. Items are strings representing paths to mbox folders, mh folders, maildirs, etc.
